Default response parser: JSON body, error on non-2xx

Source: R/helpers_request.R
parse_json_response.Rd

A generic httr2::response -> data parser: returns the parsed JSON body, and raises on a non-2xx HTTP status. Connectors with a business-level error envelope (e.g. a code/msg field that signals failure on a 200) supply their own parse_envelope to build_request() instead; this is the sensible default when the HTTP status alone tells the truth.

Usage

parse_json_response(resp)

Arguments

resp

(class<httr2_response>) the response to parse.

Value

(any) the parsed JSON body (lists, with simplifyVector = FALSE).
